title: Fr. P. de Santa Cruz to Francesc Climent, 22 Oct 1399, Arxiu Capitular de Barcelona (Puig y Puig 1920, app. XXIX)

steps.what: HathiTrust record 100676638 (Puig 1920) tried in curl and the built-in browser: Cloudflare challenge, not solved. archive.org: no copy.
Google Books full-view copy of Puig 1920 found (id CuOlkxWnk-EC, Wisconsin). Book pages and PDF were CAPTCHA-walled, but the in-volume search endpoint and signed page-image URLs answered.

In-volume search for cifra/clave/descifr: p. 466 n. 2 says italics mark the deciphered phrases and Puig rebuilt the key 'a fuerza de paciencia' from lines Climent left on docs. 1063, 461, 463; preface p. 2: 'los diez u once escritos con desconocida clave' deciphered. Appendix index lists 14 'Carta cifrada' items, 1399-1416.
Appendix pages of every cipher item fetched and checked for gaps and for what Puig left unread (page-by-page check by a subagent).

Split under the one-key rule from benedict1399: this letter is from another sender and its key is not shown to be Benedict XIII's (the key was rebuilt on doc. 1068 only), so it gets its own entry with no claim about its key.
Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): linked Puig y Puig 1920 (Google Books); no transcription possible (the cipher is not imaged)

Reading audit, per-document pass (George Lasry's sentence test): the only text is a Google Books link, now blocked to scripts, and archive.org has no copy of Puig 1920; outcome.texts_withheld set with the citation, class already solved kept.

outcome.method_basis: The text is Puig y Puig's printed decipherment (Pedro de Luna, 1920, appendix XXIX), found before the attempt; no image of the cipher exists, so nothing was checked against it.

gaps.item: The ciphertext itself (no image, not transcribed)
gaps.detail: The reading is Puig's, complete as printed; the cipher and its key could be checked only on the ACB original.

gaps.item: Puig's printed text of the letter (pp. 469-470), not in the repository
gaps.detail: Google Books blocks automated access; HathiTrust is behind a Cloudflare challenge; archive.org has no copy; a copy of the book is needed

outcome.notes: Read by Puig y Puig in 1920 (the reading is his). Identified and listed here among the 14 cipher items of his appendix; split on 14 Oct 2026 from benedict1399 because the key is not shown to be Benedict XIII's. 22 Oct 2026, reading audit: no text of the letter is in the repository; texts_withheld set with the citation. Class already solved kept (the text exists in print).

texts.summary: Fr. P. de Santa Cruz to Francesc Climent, 22 October 1399: the French ambassadors leave, and the besieged household (of Benedict XIII at Avignon) is 'in periculo mortis'.
texts.note: Decryption: Puig y Puig, Pedro de Luna (1920), appendix XXIX, pp. 469-470, deciphered passages in italics (Google Books full view); no local copy yet. No transcription: the ciphertext is not imaged or printed. Not in the repository: Google Books blocks scripted access (reading audit, 22 Oct 2026).

It was read on Google Books (CuOlkxWnk-EC) on 23 Sept 2026; Google Books and HathiTrust now block scripted access and archive.org has no copy, so nothing of the letter is in the repository (reading audit, 22 Oct 2026).
